- [**Project 8 Plus: a native recompilation of Tony Hawk's Project 8**](https://github.com/MaxLeiter/project-8-plus) - Project 8 Plus builds a native PC port of the PS3 Tony Hawk's Project 8 from a user's game copy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/project-8-plus-case/)</sub>

- [**Project Arwing: Star Fox recompiled from a matching disassembly**](https://github.com/carlosrmz009/arwing) - Disassembles Star Fox’s 65816 and SuperFX code from runtime coverage and recursive descent, reassembles it into the original ROM, then translates it statically to C on a from-scratch SNES runtime for Windows, macOS and Linux. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/project-arwing-star-fox-recomp-case/)</sub>

- [**Angelica Wardrobe: rebuilding Perfect World's fashion window**](https://github.com/TienQuangPP/angelica-wardrobe) - Rebuilds the Vietnamese Perfect World client's fashion collection window as a standalone 3D app. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/angelica-wardrobe-case/)</sub>
